name: Pazzo's
notes: Restaurant's own Wix site (pazzospizza.net) is a fully client-hydrated Wix Thunderbolt app — its /menu and /ourmenus pages return only nav-shell HTML with no priced content server-rendered (checked warmup-data JSON too, no price/dish keys), so it needed a JS-rendering path this task doesn't have. Found the restaurant's first-party Slice storefront instead (tier 2) via web search and pulled the full catalog from its __SLICE_REDUX_STATE__ JSON. 121 unique priced items after dropping 'Popular Items' (28-item duplicate sample of items counted elsewhere) and a single 'Non Display Products' item ($19.49 Cheese Pizza, explicitly flagged non-customer-facing in the data, likely a legacy/internal SKU). Markup test against 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25/1.30: no clean signature (best 14.9% at 1.25, deep in noise range) — prices include odd-cent values ($20.28, $19.04, $26.79) consistent with genuine per-topping POS pricing, not a divisor artefact. Categories reached: Pizza, Specialty Pizzas, Appetizers, Salads, Sides, Calzones, Hot Sandwiches, Cold Sandwiches, Pasta, Desserts, Beverages — full core menu. The site also lists a separate Beer and Wine Menu and a Catering Menu; both are adjunct (alcohol list / bulk catering) and the beer/wine page is client-rendered with no prices reachable without a browser, so excluded.
